representation: Canonical unpadded little-endian; Header(sec i32,nanosec u32,UTF8 byte count u32,raw bytes); seven IEEEbinary32 metadata values in original order; ranges(u32 count,IEEEbinary32 elements); intensities(same). Not ROS CDR.
float_policy: Retain every native binary32 numeric value including +/-infinity, NaN and signed zero. Do not replace readings or infer invalid/valid source values. Original Python application chooses min/obstacle behavior. NaN payload bit identity is not promised by Python float conversion.
decode: Check extent/quota/remaining byte count before allocation; preserve all fields; reject truncated, malformed/trailing values.
identity_derivation: SHA256 of the preceding profile keys only, JSON sorted keys, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii=true, no newline; excludes codec_identity and identity_derivation.
